skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and characteristics of management in modern hotel business.
Formulate theoretical foundations for hotel supervision, standards for supervisors, supervisory tools, and effective supervisory measures.
Analyze the relationship between leadership roles, tasks, and responsibilities of hotel supervisors with the achievement of business goals.
Apply effective supervisory measures during the operation and management of hotel departments.
Apply knowledge and skills learned to practical management of operational departments in hotels such as reception, rooms, and dining.
Use supervisory tools to enhance management efficiency such as creating a positive working atmosphere, resolving conflicts, motivating employees, and developing communication skills.
